domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 依据Hertz弹性接触理论描述的接触关系。
usage_overview: 在车辆—轨道动力模型中，用于描述轮轨法向弹性压缩与接触力之间的关系，依据法向压缩量计算法向接触力，也可作为不同接触建模方法的对照。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: In multibody dynamics based on force-equilibrium methods, Hertzian contact and creep theories have been applied in vehicle–track model constructions.

This model possesses high accuracy compared with Hertzian contact, FastSim, and vehicle–track coupled model in the middle-low frequency domain, and also, the advantages in computational stability are possessed.
